items.requirement: Run Google Lighthouse against an application route.
Use separate performance, SEO, and best-practices nodes.
Do not run Lighthouse accessibility by default.
Run performance three times by default.
Permit five performance runs for an important gate.
Run performance samples sequentially.
Use the median performance result.
Run SEO and best-practices once.
Store every Lighthouse report.
Mark one performance report as representative.
Use project-selected named profiles.
Keep browser, device, network, CPU, and screen controls in operator policy or reviewed profile data.
Record profile identity in the result.
Record Lighthouse and browser versions.
Record worker resource limits and benchmark index.
Use a named combined performance budget.
Support a minimum performance score.
Support maximum LCP, CLS, and TBT values.
Require every configured route to meet every configured budget value.
Permit an advisory performance node without a budget.
Report SEO and best-practices category scores.
Report every failed SEO or best-practices audit.
Require an exact route, audit, reason, and expiry for accepted audit failures.
Fail a blocking node for an unaccepted audit or budget failure.
Restrict browser traffic to the exact authorized origin.
Delete the old direct Lighthouse command and its legacy configuration authority.
Use port 9999 for the old static serve mode and port 3000 for server mode.
Use the root path when the old configuration omitted a path.
Use a 60 second default Lighthouse timeout.
Keep a configured timeout inside the parent suite deadline.
Propagate cancellation to the running browser audit.
Use a bounded worker environment for the Lighthouse process.
Fail when a configured category threshold is not met.
Fail when a configured Lighthouse category is absent.
Keep score findings visible when score policy is advisory.
Use runner-owned evidence paths and unique report names.
Publish a completed report only after the temporary report is complete.
Reject project-controlled report output paths.
Return an execution error when Lighthouse or its report fails.
Remove the one-run mixed-category invocation that coupled accessibility to performance.
